title: Art. 2.2 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 2 - General, 2.2
content: In developing procedures aimed at the efficient clearance of entering or departing aircraft, Contracting States shall take into account the application of aviation security and narcotics control measures, where appropriate.
